stories.title: Ballroom or Bulldozer? Trump Asks Supreme Court to Green-Light White House Construction
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Takes Ballroom Fight to SCOTUS as Activist Judges Block Presidential Property Improvements

stories.poll_option1_desc: President controls the grounds; courts shouldn't micromanage White House renovations.
stories.poll_option2_desc: A historic public building shouldn't be remade on one president's whim.

stories.title: Fired for Politics or Fired for Cause? Prosecutor Sues DOJ Over Anti-Abortion Case Dismissal

stories.poll_question: Was the prosecutor's firing political retaliation?

stories.poll_option2_desc: Firing prosecutors over case outcomes destroys DOJ independence and rule of law.

stories.poll_question: Was ending the Iran ceasefire the right call?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Extending the truce only lets Iran rearm and stall for time.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Bombing threats against a mediator invite endless war and higher gas prices.

stories.title: Deportation Machine or Death Trap? ICE Detainee Hospitalized as Body Camera Gaps Widen

stories.poll_option1_desc: Cameras endanger officers and hand ammunition to anti-enforcement activists.

stories.title: Ethics Reckoning or Partisan Pile-On? House Probes Democrat Jimmy Gomez Over Misconduct Claims

stories.poll_option1_desc: Democrats demand accountability from others; the standard applies to them too.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Consensual personal conduct isn't a crime; let the committee finish its work.

stories.title: Crypto Breakthrough or Blatant Self-Dealing? Trump-Backed World Liberty Wins Bank Charter

stories.poll_option2_desc: Regulators approving the president's family business is a textbook conflict.

stories.title: Ally Discipline or Alliance Sabotage? Trump Orders Cuts to South Korea War Games

stories.poll_option2_desc: Cutting readiness drills weakens deterrence and rewards Pyongyang for nothing.
